name: Mud Boar
flavor: A tusked scavenger fattened on drowned roots, it charges anything that disturbs its wallow.

name: Mud Wasp
flavor: Its sting carries the sour rot of the flood-marsh; a swarm can drop a pack-strider in minutes.

name: Swamp Crab
flavor: Armored in silt-cemented shell, it waits half-buried until a foot strays within claw reach.

name: Gutter Rat
flavor: Bred fat in the drowned undercities, it fears nothing that bleeds and travels in the dozens.

name: Bog Hound
flavor: A lean marsh-runner that hunts in coordinated packs, driving prey into the sucking mud.

name: Mudling
flavor: A crude thing of animate silt, barely more than a grasping fist given the will to grasp.

name: Aetheric Ooze
flavor: A puddle of dissolving hunger, its acids fed by leaking Aether from a cracked conduit below.

name: Aetherbat
flavor: Blind and shrieking, it navigates the buried halls by a sonar keyed to Aetheric resonance.

name: Mud Strider
flavor: Long-legged and quick, it skates the flood-flats on splayed feet and stabs from a distance.

name: Aetheric Leech
flavor: It fastens on and drinks the warmth from you — and the charge, if you carry any.

name: Mud Tortoise
flavor: Ancient and patient, its shell has turned aside blades since before the waters rose.

name: Aetheric Spider
flavor: Its web hums faintly with stored charge; the strands cling, and the bite burns cold.

name: Scrap Drone
flavor: A salvage automaton gone feral, still running the last order it was ever given: clear the area.

name: Aetheric Worm
flavor: It bores through packed silt on a trail of hissing acid, surfacing only to feed.

name: Mud Imp
flavor: A spiteful little marsh-sprite that strikes from cover and vanishes before you turn.

name: Aetheric Slug
flavor: Slow as tar and twice as ruinous, it leaves a smoking track that etches stone.

name: Mud Spider
flavor: It spins snares between drowned pillars and waits, patient, for the strands to tremble.

name: Aetheric Raven
flavor: A carrion bird that roosts on dead conduits, its feathers oil-slicked with Aetheric residue.

name: Mud Lurker
flavor: It lies flat in the shallows as harmless ground until the mud itself rears up and swings.

name: Silt Serpent
flavor: A coil of muscle and venom that swims the flood-channels, striking before the ripple reaches you.

name: Aetheric Drone
flavor: A war-era sentry still on patrol, its lens sweeping the dark for anything that moves.

name: Silt Stalker
flavor: It reads the tremor of your steps through the mud and opens the throat before you see it.

name: Mud Viper
flavor: Small, drab, and lethal — its bite floods the blood with marsh-rot in a single beat.

name: Dust Fiend
flavor: A whirl of grit and stale Aether given shape, it flays exposed skin with razoring wind.

name: Rust Lurker
flavor: A corroded machine that hunts by heat, dragging its seized joints toward anything warm.

name: Bog Creeper
flavor: A tangle of animate vine that reaches from the reeds; cut it and it only grows a new lash.

name: Mud Hound Alpha
flavor: Scarred and cunning, it leads the pack from the front and takes the killing bite for itself.

name: Plague Moth
flavor: Its wing-dust chokes the lungs and blooms with sickness; the swarm follows the dying.

name: Aetheric Salamander
flavor: It nests in vent-heat and breathes it back out, indifferent to fire and hungry for flesh.

name: Aetheric Scarab
flavor: An armored beetle the size of a shield, its carapace crackling with siphoned charge.

name: Aetheric Shrike
flavor: It impales its kills on broken rebar and comes back for them between hunts.

name: Iron Spider
flavor: A clockwork weaver whose legs end in drills, ticking as it circles for the soft angle.

name: Mud Spirit
flavor: The lingering will of something drowned, it passes through steel and chills the blood to touch.

name: Mud Harpy
flavor: A shrieking flood-scavenger that stoops from the rafters, all talons and stinking wings.

name: Shifting Shade
flavor: A smear of living dark that thins and reforms, always a half-step from where you strike.

name: Mud Golem
flavor: A slab of packed clay walking on borrowed purpose — flood-sludge that woke where the trapped Etheric charge ran hottest, a scrap of the empire's own thermodynamic hubris up on its feet. Blunt force cracks what blades cannot.

name: Aetheric Hound
flavor: A beast rebuilt by leaking Aether — too many teeth, and a hunger that never banks.

name: Mud Siren
flavor: Its song bends the will toward the deep water; sailors of the flood-roads carry wax for a reason.

name: Aetheric Apparition
flavor: A half-there thing of cold light, it swipes with hands that pass through armor to the nerve.

name: Steam Walker
flavor: A pressure-driven war-frame venting scalding clouds, slow but ruinous when it connects.

name: Rock Basilisk
flavor: Its flat gaze stiffens the muscles to stone; hunters learn to strike by sound alone.

name: Steel Hound
flavor: A guard-machine with a beast's ferocity, its jaws rated to shear through plate.

name: Shifting Phantom
flavor: It phases between the layers of the ruin, landing blows from angles that shouldn't exist.

name: Flesh Weaver
flavor: A ruin of grafted meat that knits its wounds shut mid-fight and reaches for more material.

name: Jade Serpent
flavor: Beautiful and quiet, its green scales hide a venom that stops the heart three beats later.

name: Mud Cyclops
flavor: A one-eyed brute of hardened silt whose gaze focuses the light into a searing lance.

name: Crystalline Entity
flavor: A lattice of grown Aether-crystal that rings when struck and shatters into cutting shards.

name: Aether Serpent
flavor: It swims the charged air of dead reactor halls, its bite delivering a killing jolt.

name: Steam Golem
flavor: A boiler on legs, each hammer-blow announced by a shriek of escaping pressure.

name: Aetheric Harpy
flavor: Its shriek alone can stagger a line; the talons that follow finish the work.

name: Clockwork Knight
flavor: A dueling automaton still keeping its ancient forms, precise, tireless, and merciless.

name: Mud Wraith
flavor: A drowned shade wearing a crust of silt, it claws with hands that were once a person's.

name: Aetheric Ghost
flavor: It slips inside the unwary and turns their own hands against the rest of the party.

name: Mud Ogre
flavor: A hill of a creature that swings a wrenched-off pillar like a club and rarely misses twice.

name: Stone Warden
flavor: A gate-sentinel of the old cities, still standing its post ages after the gate rotted away.

name: Golem Knight
flavor: A war-construct forged for the sieges before the Flood, its edge undulled by the centuries.

name: Aetheric Gargoyle
flavor: It roosts as a statue until you pass beneath, then drops with the weight of carved stone.

name: Silt Horror
flavor: A mass of flailing tentacles that hauls itself from the mire, regrowing every limb you sever.

name: Aetheric Lion
flavor: A maned predator remade by the Aether, its roar a physical blow before the claws land.

name: Mud Serpent
flavor: It buries itself in the bank and erupts around your legs, tightening with every breath.

name: Aetheric Cyclops
flavor: A towering mutant whose single lensed eye gathers stray Aether into a cutting beam.

name: Steam Spider
flavor: A boiler-fed weaver that vents scalding bursts and skitters faster than its bulk suggests.

name: Aetheric Banshee
flavor: Its wail carries grief loud enough to bruise; the sound arrives before the shape does.

name: Mud Drake
flavor: A lesser flood-dragon that breathes a choking gout of superheated silt, then wades in.

name: Clockwork Serpent
flavor: A segmented brass coil that constricts with mechanical patience and never tires.

name: Silt Guardian
flavor: A monument-beast set to defend a drowned vault, it answers trespass with an earth-splitting slam.

name: Aetheric Beast
flavor: A nameless thing the Aether made, all speed and appetite, gone before its wounds can be counted.

name: Architectural Sentinel
flavor: A colossal guard-frame woven into the ruin itself; it wakes only for the gravest intrusion.

name: Mud Elemental
flavor: The flood given a body — tons of animate silt that reforms faster than steel can carve it.

name: Aether Golem
flavor: A construct built around a caged Aether core, its blows landing with the weight of a collapse.

name: Bog Dragon
flavor: The apex of the drowned marsh, its breath a searing torrent and its hide a wall of scale.

name: Metal Hydra
flavor: A many-headed war-machine that grows a new head for every one you take; aim for the body.

name: Storm Walker
flavor: A lightning-throwing colossus of the old grid, thunder answering each of its slow strides.

name: Aetheric Wyvern
flavor: A charge-veined flyer that stoops from the dark with a tail that cracks like a whip.

name: Mud Titan
flavor: A moving hill of the Flood's own making, each footfall a small quake felt through the floor.

name: Mech Sentinel
flavor: A pre-Flood defense platform, its beam-cannon still zeroed on the corridor it has held for ages.

name: Mud Elemental Spawn
flavor: A shard of a greater Elemental, sent ahead as a wave of grasping, reforming silt.

name: Obsidian Sentinel
flavor: Carved from volcanic glass and older than the cities, it strikes with edges that never chip.

name: Mud Monarch
flavor: A crowned aberration that rules a drowned court, its every slash trailing regal contempt.

name: Stone Chimera
flavor: Three beasts fused in stone by a failed working, each head hunting on its own cruel logic.

name: Iron Titan
flavor: A siege-frame the size of a tower gate, its fist rated to fold a bulkhead in a single blow.

name: Mud Siren Queen
flavor: Her song does not lure — it despairs, draining the will to lift a blade as she closes.

name: Aetheric Guardian
flavor: A relic warden humming with barely-caged power, sworn to a vault whose owners are dust.

name: Aetheric Phoenix
flavor: It dies in fire and rises from its own ash; only cutting it down between rebirths will do.

name: Sludge Behemoth
flavor: A slow avalanche of living muck whose every stomp buckles the ground for yards around.

name: Aetheric Horror
flavor: A shape the mind refuses to hold, its touch flaying thought as readily as flesh.

name: Aetheric Minotaur
flavor: A charging horror of Aether-warped muscle, its great axe swung with earth-splitting force.

name: Aetheric Leviathan
flavor: A titan of the flooded deeps that surfaces to crush, dragging whole spans down with it.

name: Mud Leviathan
flavor: A wave with a will, it rears from the flood-channel and comes down like a broken dam.

name: Aetheric Chimera
flavor: A blur of fused predators, striking from three angles before the first wound registers.

name: Mud Demon
flavor: A malice given a mud-and-sinew body, it opens wounds faster than they can be bound.

name: Aetheric Kraken
flavor: It reaches from the drowned dark with tentacles that crush stone and never lose their grip.

name: Mud Lich
flavor: A drowned sorcerer that refused the water's peace, pulsing dark Aether from a silt-caked crown.

name: Mud Giant
flavor: A brute the height of a ruin's second floor, its stomp enough to throw a party off its feet.

name: Aetheric Necromancer
flavor: It draws the warmth from the living to mend itself, and the dead rise where it walks.

name: Aetheric Behemoth
flavor: A slow-moving cataclysm of caged Aether, each smash landing with the finality of a rockfall.

name: Aetherkin
flavor: The un-dead of the old power-halls, animated by the Aether they died steeped in.

name: Reclaimer Ambusher
flavor: A scavenger-guild raider who fires from cover and fades before the bolt's echo dies.

name: Black Cloak Agent
flavor: A blade-for-hire of the hidden orders, working from shadow with a poisoned edge.

signatureWeapon.name: the Hollow Edge
signatureWeapon.reason: You crouch for the blade — the Hollow Edge, the black mark of the Forgotten Order's enforcers, its steel weeping a faint corruption that fogs the air. But the grip is wrong. It's honed: razored along the inner curve so the handle itself is a second blade, and only one of its edges is meant for the enemy. Take it up untrained and you flay your own palm to the bone. Only a hand that knows the Order's hold — that two-finger grip they teach behind sealed doors — can carry it. You leave it where it fell.

name: Aetheric Lich
flavor: An arch-undead sustained by a core of stolen souls, its drain colder than the grave it left.

name: Mud Tyrant
flavor: A self-made sovereign of the drowned wastes, ruling by the crush of an armored fist.

name: Hollow King
flavor: A crowned husk on a rotted throne, hollow of all but the will to make the world hollow too.

name: Iron Worm
flavor: A boring-machine turned monster, its segmented body grinding through wall and warrior alike.

name: Bog Wyrm
flavor: A venom-fanged serpent-drake of the deep marsh, quick as a struck match and twice as ruinous.

name: Voidspawn Matriarch
flavor: The brood-mother of the void-touched, spitting corrosive young that hatch as they land.

name: Tartarian Reaver
flavor: A warlord of the old bloodlines, armored and merciless, cutting a red sweep through any line.

name: Silt Thief
flavor: A quick-fingered marsh-rat who'd rather cut your purse than your throat — but will do both.

name: Disc Hijacker
flavor: A road-brigand who clubs travelers senseless and makes off with their Discs and their boots.

name: Mud Monarch Purifier
flavor: A zealot-knight of a drowned faith, wielding a lance of channeled radiance against the unclean.

name: Drowned Aetherkin
flavor: One of the Aetherkin — a Tartarian the flood sealed under and the Aether would not let rest. Reanimated, frightened, running on the muscle-memory of a life it half-remembers. It defends itself; it does not hunt.

name: Mud-Wracked Aetherkin
flavor: One of the Aetherkin, caked in the mud that mummified it — the flood-dead of old Tartaria, awake and afraid. Slow and defensive; dangerous only to those who press it.
